passages.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good.\r\nGive thanks to the LORD.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God is the God of all gods.\r\nGive thanks to Him.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: The Lord of lords rules over all other lords.\r\nHe deserves thanks.\r\nHis loving devotion lasts forever.
passages.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
God acts alone.
God does great wonders.
His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God made the heavens.\r\nHe used His wisdom.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God spread out the earth upon the waters.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־ הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God made the great lights.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God made the sun.\r\nThe sun rules over the day.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
God made the moon.
God made the stars.
The moon and stars rule over the night.
God’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God struck down the firstborn sons in Egypt.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְמַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God brought Israel out from among the Egyptians.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God acted with a mighty hand.\r\nGod used an outstretched arm.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God divided the Red Sea in two parts.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God led Israel through the midst of the Red Sea.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God swept Pharaoh into the Red Sea.\r\nGod swept Pharaoh’s army into the Red Sea.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God led His people.\r\nHe brought them through the wilderness.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God struck down great kings.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְ֭מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God killed mighty kings.
God’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God struck down Sihon.\r\nSihon was king of the Amorites.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
God defeated Og.
Og was king of Bashan.
God’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God gave the land of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan to His people.\r\nHe gave this land as an inheritance.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God gave a heritage to Israel.\r\nIsrael is His servant.\r\nGod’s loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: נַ֭חֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God remembered us when we were low.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God freed us from our enemies.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon: God gives food to every creature.\r\nHis loving devotion endures forever.
passages.original: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
passages.sermon:
God rules in heaven.
God deserves our thanks.
God shows loving devotion.
God’s loving devotion never ends.
passages.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
